correctness.rationale: The exact ordinary orbit CW model follows by barycentric no-inversions; exhaustive enumeration yields 9,33,49,25 cell orbits. Signed deletion boundaries compose to zero with full integer Smith diagonals ranks 8,25,24 and all factors 1. A complete 49-relator presentation eliminates all 25 generators by valid Tietze moves. Hence pi1 trivial and integral homology Z in degrees 0 and 3 only; Hurewicz and Whitehead prove the homotopy S3 claim. The embedded verifier recomputes all critical finite data.

value.rationale: The full relabeling quotient is the canonical unlabeled version of the basic graphic-matroid forest complex, whose labeled wedge of fifty-one S3 is well-known from shellability. Determining the actual nonfree geometric orbit space up to homotopy, especially its fundamental group and integral classes rather than rational invariant rank, is a natural and motivated structural question; the complete homotopy type S3 is a substantive classification of a concrete first rank-four complete-graph case, not a selected numeric variation.
